run_hydra_app: run a Hydra app that prints the merged configuration as YAML to stdout
create_hydra_config_app: create a Python app decorated with hydra.main that loads config from a conf directory
print_omegaconf_yaml: print an OmegaConf DictConfig object as formatted YAML output
configure_hydra_defaults: configure a Hydra app to use a defaults list for selecting database config options
review_hydra_main_decorator: review the hydra.main decorator usage with version_base, config_path, and config_name parameters
